card.title: The Expert Blind Spot
card.instruction: Perform mastery everywhere except one specific subject. Deflect it at first, reinterpret it later, and let each return increase the pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The engine is simple, apart from that red switch, which we'll leave alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to know what it does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, understand the twelve systems surrounding it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They all point to the switch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A useful opportunity to revise all twelve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've explained the engine's fuel feed and cooling. Leave that red switch; we'll cover it later.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to start it for the demonstration.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, let me show you the beautifully simple throttle linkage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The audience is here. The label says START.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the manufacturer's interpretation. Before we endorse it publicly, I'll explain why the engine is currently stopped.

mechanism: A performs engine expertise around a red switch, defers it and reinterprets its label under public pressure.
confusable: Unlike simple ignorance, A must sustain surrounding mastery and change the avoided subject's meaning when it returns.
comparison: S219-a questions a manufacturer label before an audience; S219-b claims definitional authority during a landlord call.
